origin.description: Gauss-Newton minimization of a sum of squares.
origin.usage: gaussNewton(x0, Ffun, Jfun = NULL, maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2), ...)
origin.value: Gauss-Newton minimization of a sum of squares.
origin.example: print(with(gaussNewton(c(0, 0), function(x) x - c(1, 2)), c(xs, fs)))

translation.description: Gauss-Newton minimization of a sum of squares.
translation.usage: gaussNewton(x0, Ffun, Jfun = NULL, maxiter = 100, tol = .Machine$double.eps^(1/2), ...)
translation.value: Gauss-Newton minimization of a sum of squares.
translation.example: print(np.concatenate([np.ravel(gaussNewton(np.array([0.0, 0.0]), lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]))['xs']), [gaussNewton(np.array([0.0, 0.0]), lambda x: np.asarray(x, float) - np.array([1.0, 2.0]))['fs']]]))
